+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from .core import Context
+from .core import Option
+from .parser import _OptionParser
+
+
+class NullableSecondaryFlag(Option):
+    """Register a paired boolean flag's secondary spelling with a value of None."""
+
+    def add_to_parser(self, parser: _OptionParser, ctx: Context) -> None:
+        if not (self.is_flag and self.is_bool_flag and self.secondary_opts):
+            super().add_to_parser(parser, ctx)
+            return
+
+        if self.multiple:
+            action = "append_const"
+        elif self.count:
+            action = "count_const"
+        else:
+            action = "store_const"
+
+        parser.add_option(
+            obj=self, opts=self.opts, dest=self.name, action=action, const=True
+        )
+        parser.add_option(
+            obj=self,
+            opts=self.secondary_opts,
+            dest=self.name,
+            action=action,
+            const=None,
+        )
diff --git a/tests/test_nullable_secondary_flag.py b/tests/test_nullable_secondary_flag.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..baaf22d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_nullable_secondary_flag.py
@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+import pytest
+
+import click
+from click.nullable_secondary_flag import NullableSecondaryFlag
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("args", "multiple", "expected"),
+    [
+        (["--on"], False, True),
+        (["--off"], False, None),
+        (["--on", "--off"], False, None),
+        (["--on", "--off"], True, [True, None]),
+    ],
+)
+def test_nullable_secondary_flag(args, multiple, expected):
+    option = NullableSecondaryFlag(["--on/--off"], multiple=multiple)
+    command = click.Command("test", params=[option])
+    parser = command.make_parser(click.Context(command))
+
+    values, _, _ = parser.parse_args(args)
+
+    assert values == {"on": expected}
notes:
The subclass registers paired boolean spellings with True and None and delegates all other registrations to Option. Added parser-level regression tests without editing existing modules.
